name: Tranquil Tempest
source:
Juni’s life revolves around a virtual reality fighting game named Trankill. She is one of those people for which Trankill is more than a hobby or a sport, it’s a job. The only one she can have. She and her fellow refugees from the now destroyed island of Silen, are shunned by society and forced into solitude. For far too long she has ignored her past and been content with surviving day to day.

One day she hits “Accept” on a notification from Trankill. Now all these people are appearing in her life. Maybe they have answers to questions she didn't know she has.

[from [url=https://selavi.itch.io/tranquil-tempest]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
朱妮的生活围绕一款名为Trankill的虚拟现实格斗游戏展开。对她来说，Trankill不只是兴趣或运动，更是一份工作，也是她唯一能做的工作。她与来自已被摧毁的西伦岛的难民同伴遭到社会排斥，被迫过着与世隔绝的生活。太长时间以来，她一直忽视自己的过去，满足于日复一日地活下去。

某天，她点击了Trankill通知上的“接受”。从那以后，这些人纷纷出现在她的生活中。也许，他们能回答一些她甚至不知道自己正在思考的问题。

[来源：[url=https://selavi.itch.io/tranquil-tempest]Itch.io[/url]]
